$Comment: Take the supper round once The Feast is done: a plate of the leftovers to each of Martha's three
helpers. One COMPLETE_QUEST criterion per delivery, each naming its quest's id
and every criterion must complete. A quest counts when its pay is collected, and the three come back
once in each year's feast, so this year's copy waits on this year's round.
It inherits the yearly occurrence from Harvest_Feast_Achievement_Base, so each year has its own copy
with the year in its title, and the full_table tag counts it toward The Full Table. Each year's copy
pays Harvest Coins and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, Crafting XP as the supper deliveries pay it, both
waiting on the achievements page until the player collects them. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the
hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the
coins still pay. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_supper_round.
